_doc: projectaudit registry (OWNER 11-06: 'a daily or scheduled check to see if projects are effective and useful ... with all projects').
ONE entry per project kind: its PURPOSE, the rows that show USE (output after it is built), the rows that show a FAILED attempt,
the expected use per day, and how many days without use make a finished project DORMANT. Read by scripts/host/projectaudit.py.
Kinds are matched to a record's plot name by `plots` (fnmatch, first entry in this file wins). A plot no entry matches is UNMEASURED.
Signal spec: {row: skill.name, where: {detail key: value}, qty: 1 | field | [fields], label}. Values: 'x' equal, ['a','b'] any of,
'!x' not equal, '~x' contains, '!~x' does not contain, '>0' a number above 0, '*' present. 'status' matches skill.status.
where.project = '@plot' ties a row to the project; a spec without it is TOWN-scoped (credited to every project of the kind in that pool).
qty: a field's number, or the sum of the ':N' counts in it (dug=cobblestone:6 -> 6); a list sums its fields; 1 = one per row.
emitters: strings of which AT LEAST ONE must appear in the DEPLOYED bot source for a zero to be believed (the positive control: a
build that cannot log the row is UNMEASURED, never DORMANT). measured=false: no row shows use; upkeep and presence are reported.
Expected rates are INITIAL service targets (11-06), not measured baselines; recalibrate from the first weeks of daily reports.

treefarm.purpose: renewable wood: fell grown trees, replant saplings

canefarm.purpose: renewable sugar cane (paper, books for the enchanting shop)

shaft.purpose: the common mineshaft: a safe stair down to the ore levels and back
shaft.note: ores brought up are not attributed to the shaft by any row; trips are the use signal. ok=0 why=no_plan (no stair plan from where the bot stands) is not counted as an attempt

workshop.purpose: the town workshop: crafting table + furnace where town materials are made and smelted
workshop.unit: jobs done at the workshop stations
workshop.note: ws=w: the job used the workshop's own station; ws=o: another station; elsewhere counts are context (owner: 'crafts and smelts done there vs placed elsewhere')

storehouse.purpose: sorted shared storage: deposits land in the right labelled chest, misplaced items are moved home
storehouse.note: sort accuracy = deposit_home / (deposit_home + deposit_overflow): t0 is the item's own labelled chest

storehub.purpose: the sorted storage hall: hopper intake + a clerk who sorts it into the hall chests

market.purpose: the market (market-01): idle bots trade town surplus (iron, coal, sticks, panes, water buckets) with merchants near town for emeralds, then buy the town's wants; job blocks beside free jobless villagers
market.note: trades/day = trades_sold + trades_bought; emeralds_earned sums the run rows' earned=; items_bought sums _trade op=buy n=. The offers file appears at the first window read; until then the kind is absent, never dormant. Design docs/reports/market-design-2026-11-06.md

yard.purpose: the cobble stockpile: surplus cobble stored on the ground, drawn back for building bills

tidy.purpose: groundskeeping: clear town clutter, fill holes and dips, grade rough ground
tidy.complete_note: finished: this ring of town ground is done; nothing logs whether it STAYS tidy (no ground census row), so a finished tidy is not judged; the next ring is a new generation
tidy.note: the OUTCOME the owner asked for (holes, dips and roughness falling) is not logged: no ground census row exists; this measures work done

paths.purpose: paths and roads: walked over between the town's places
paths.note: no row names a path cell; use = distinct (bot, minute) whose logged bot.pos stands on a path column (rows sample positions, so this undercounts)

well.purpose: the disposal well: junk tossed out of bags (and surplus cobble)

chests.purpose: the town chests: bots bank surplus and withdraw what they need
chests.note: _withdraw_pick failures are mostly outcome=short (the chest had none): demand unmet, not the chests failing, so they are not counted

composter.purpose: the composter: leaf litter and seeds into bone meal

walldemo.purpose: demolish the old wall ring (a one-off: complete IS the purpose)

house.purpose: buildings and monuments: shelter, town hall, look-out towers, the ziggurat -- to stand intact and be visited
house.note: NO USE SIGNAL: no bot uses a house, hall, tower or monument for anything; 'lit' is not logged by the bots (structcount reads unlit rooms from the world). Reported: upkeep (repairs, failed repairs, last intact check) and presence (bot-minutes inside the footprint, builders included)

wall.purpose: the town wall: a boundary that stays intact
wall.note: NO USE SIGNAL for 'kept intact' beyond upkeep: repair visits (placed>0) mean it was damaged and fixed; complete/no_effect visits mean it was checked intact

decor.purpose: decoration: flower pots, ferns, hedges, lanterns, signs (towndress lights + signs)
decor.note: NO USE SIGNAL: decoration is looked at, not used; upkeep rows (_decor op=pots/ferns, _dress op=signs) are reported as upkeep

stepwell.purpose: the stepwell: a tank of water (or lava) to draw from
stepwell.note: NO USE SIGNAL: no bot code draws water or lava from the stepwell yet (_stepwell rows are building rows)

shopchest.note: NO USE SIGNAL: withdraw/bank rows do not name these chests

siteprep.purpose: town planning: land plan and prepared building plots (on demand)
siteprep.note: a plan and an on-demand service: _siteprep op=handed (a prepared plot used) and _land_plan rows are reported, not judged
